consensus_summary: SC-1 (R1-W1, DA-M1) consensus, undisputed; SC-3 (EIC-W1, R3-W2) consensus; SC-2, SC-4, SC-5, SC-6 single-seat undisputed; SC-7 minor items. No SPLIT; no DA CRITICAL. Transcribed from manuscript/12_REVIEWER_PANEL_round1.md Editorial Decision Letter.

items.competence_basis: TMI associate editor for EIT/reconstruction; handles the journal's four Regular-Paper criteria and the established-method exclusion

corroborating_sources.competence_basis: Multi-task learning researcher from the broader medical-image-analysis community

cost_scope.locator: §1 last paragraph, §4.1 title and first paragraph, §5

items.description: Contribution framed as an architecture verdict rather than as measurement-chain sensitivity, which is the paper's TMI-relevant claim

evidence_anchor.quote: Because the branch sits downstream of the reconstruction, the answer is also a statement about how sensitive a post-reconstruction network is

items.suggested_action: Reframe the stated contribution as measurement-chain sensitivity of a post-reconstruction stage in §1 last paragraph, §4.1 title/first paragraph, §5.
items.verification_criteria: §1 last paragraph, §4.1 opening and §5 state the contribution as measurement-chain sensitivity.

items.competence_basis: TMI associate editor for EIT/reconstruction; handles the journal's four Regular-Paper criteria and the established-method exclusion
items.description: The absence of measured data is acknowledged but not defended against the journal's precedent

evidence_anchor.quote: no thoracic geometry, and no measured data

items.suggested_action: Defend the simulation-only design in the manuscript (why registered controls need simulated ground truth).
items.verification_criteria: The manuscript states why the registered design requires simulated ground truth.

items.competence_basis: Statistician-engineer working on ML evaluation methodology: paired designs, seeds as replication units, preregistration, distribution shift

corroborating_sources.competence_basis: Devil's Advocate seat: strongest counter-argument, alternative explanations, over-generalisation

evidence_anchor.quote: The registered training and primary level was 40 dB.

cost_scope.locator: retrain D and B_wide at 20 dB (116 runs) as a registered addendum; Title, Abstract, §3, §4.1, §4.4, §5

items.description: Evaluation-only sweep under 40 dB-trained models; distribution shift and 'under threat' not separable; headline generalises beyond the tested condition

evidence_anchor.quote: The registered secondary sweep evaluated the trained models, without retraining, on test frames regenerated at 60, 50, 40, 30 and 20 dB

items.suggested_action: Separate distribution-shift from weak-component threat: retrain D and B_wide at 20 dB and report as a registered addendum, or narrow title/abstract/§4.1 to the tested training condition and add the confound to Limitations.
items.verification_criteria: Headline scope matches the design: the retrained contrast is reported as its own registered quantity, or the claim is narrowed to a network trained at the registered level.

cost_scope.locator: geometry-level bootstrap from per-image files; one sentence in §2.4; Supplementary

items.description: Seed-level intervals describe training-run variability, not phantom-population variability

items.suggested_action: State in §2.4 that seed-level intervals describe training-run variability; add a geometry-level bootstrap of the 40 and 20 dB contrasts to Supplementary.
